notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register's description is cut off mid-sentence in the cached page (ends 'from Kna'), so the story quotes only the part before the cut. No build date, staffing, fire history, removal date or site condition found after two searches and about four page reads. The Mon Forest Towns sentence is forest-wide context, not a claim that Little Mountain is one of the 22 towers. The story is about 125 words, near the 120-word floor. A Monongahela National Forest history or a Pocahontas County source would be the best next lookup.
